dvids.title: USS Pinckney Begins Second Depot Modernization Period Under DDG MOD 2.0 Program
dvids.desc:
WASHINGTON, D.C. — The Arleigh Burke-class guided missile destroyer USS Pinckney
(DDG 91) has commenced the second phase of upgrades under the Destroyer Modernization 2.0
(DDG MOD 2.0) program in a Depot Modernization Period (DMP) at General Dynamics
NASSCO in San Diego.
